english: A quiet morning…
Haruka and Koto too… hmm,\nis everyone still asleep?
Then, some morning training on my own…
Hm? A call on the communicator? Reki, huh.
This is Houki Shinonono. What is it?
Yes. I have an urgent report.
Shirayuki has disappeared.
What!?
Sorry to keep you waiting.
I ran here as fast as I could!
I heard Shirayuki-chan disappeared and I was so shocked!\nIs it true!?
Yes. Her room showed no signs of disturbance,\nso abduction seems unlikely.
So you're saying she left on her own?
Most likely.
Where could she have gone?
Hauu, I have no idea!
Please calm down.\nIf you lose your composure,\nyour abilities are halved.
So I just need to calm down, right?\nBreathe in, breathe out… phew.\nUgh, but I can't think of anything!
Can't we search with all of Butei High's resources?
If the commotion grows, the search will only get more confused,\nand finding her harder.
That's no good, then!
Butei aren't trained to move in large groups like an army.\nTo perform at their best,\nsmall team operations are best.
Anyway, let's think about where Shirayuki went.\nCan we assume she moved at night?
Yes. Usable transportation would be limited.
That's right! Wasn't Shirayuki-chan not allowed\nanywhere but the shrine and Butei High?
So it's hard to imagine she went far\nin the middle of the night, right?
Her range is limited, then.\nAny other leads?
Shirayuki probably left because of the demon sword Durandal…\nit reportedly never shows itself to people. A cautious one.
Then a place out of sight would be suspicious, indeed.\nMaybe the demon sword is hiding somewhere nearby, indeed?
Shirayuki only knows the area around Butei High,\nand Durandal never shows itself to people.\nCan't we narrow it down with those two conditions?
Reki-chan, can I borrow your phone?\nI'll call Shirayuki-chan.
Go ahead.
//The number you have dialed is either out of the service area\nor has the phone turned off,\nso your call cannot be completed.
Huh!?
No signal…?\nReki, are there any places near Butei High\nwhere cell phones get no signal?
If anywhere… underground.
Underground? Butei High has an underground?
Yes. The megafloat that Butei High sits on\nhas a maze-like underground.
Durandal, the demon sword that doesn't want to be seen,\nsummoned Shirayuki underground…?
Seems quite likely.
Let's go!! Reki-chan, lead the way!
Wait for us, Shirayuki-chan!
…It's dark… but ahead lies…
…You're there, aren't you?\nAs promised, I came alone.
//…I shall keep my promise as well.\nI will do Butei High no harm.
//Nor to those people\nyou were worried about.
Why do you want me?\nSomeone like me, with no real ability.
//No false modesty.\nYou're a great uncut gem.
//And when that gem is poorly guarded,\nit's only natural hands reach for it.
//Follow me, Shirayuki.
//I'll take you to the Yiu.\nYour power should be honed there.
I don't have any real ability…
//Refuse, and I'll simply blow up\nthe underground powder magazine of Butei High.
No! Anything but that…!!
Don't resist. Just stay obedient.\nLike you've done all this time,\nkeeping my contact with you secret… forever…
Ugh…
//Wait!!
That voice!?
I won't let you kidnap Shirayuki-chan!!
…I anticipated you might track this place down.\nBut this fast… that's outside my calculations.
Of course!\nBecause we're friends!!
Huh…
Ah… well, Haruka-chan's friends are my friends too!\nI'll protect you no matter what!!
Red Angel… one half of Twin Angel…\nI'd heard of your extraordinary speed and power,\nand now I see.
You know about me?
It's only natural to research potential enemies.\nBut no matter what power you have,\nthere are plenty of ways to seal it.
Listen. I've planted bombs\nin Butei High's underground ammunition depot.\nYou know what happens if you resist, don't you?
So that's how you blackmailed Shirayuki-chan\ninto coming here… Unforgivable!
There's nothing you can do.\nSurrender too. I won't treat you badly.
Tch…!
Follow me, Red Angel.\nYou too have already fallen into my hands.
//Heh, we'll see about that.
Sorry, but I already removed the bombs!
What?
I got help from Butei High students\nand removed the bombs from the depot!\nAll that remains is to strike you down!
But the bombs haven't been fully disposed of yet, have they?\nIf I activate the detonator here,\nyou won't get off unscathed…
What! You sniped the detonator!?
I am a single bullet. Bullets have no human heart.\nSo they think nothing.\nThey simply fly toward their objective.
Reki-chan!
This is the end, Durandal!
Don't call me that.\nI dislike the name humans gave me.
What?
Just as Lupin the Fourth said,\nyour bravery and earnestness at least\nare worthy of praise.
Lupin the Fourth…?
She means Riko-san, indeed!
The phantom thief Twintail—Riko Mine!?
But my ancestor, Joan of Arc,\nwas more beautiful and more brave than any of you.
That name… you mean the Saint of France,\nJoan of Arc?
Ehh!? …Who's that?
Hmph. I come from another world.\nNo wonder you don't know.
Um… oh, she's the one from the textbooks!?
But Joan of Arc was burned at the stake,\nso she shouldn't have any descendants…
The one who was killed was a body double.
I am of a clan of strategists.\nLurking in darkness, manipulating history,\nwe passed down pride and cunning.
I am the 30th-generation Joan of Arc.
I've talked too long.\nI wasn't told to bring you back.\nYou'll meet your end here, underground.
Ice Flower of Orleans—scatter as silver ice!
Everyone!\nShe's a mage (Matsugi)—she's dangerous!
So what.\nI've steeled myself to fight anything!
Haven't fought a mage yet, huh?\nHeh, sounds fun!
Huh…?
Leave it to me, rest easy—Red Angel!\nEveryone, let's go!
Hmph… a miscalculation—what my clan despises.\nOne gear slightly off, and everything warps…
Drop the sword, Jehanne!\nYou've already lost.
Lost? Don't make me laugh.\nAs long as the holy sword Durandal exists, I cannot be defeated!
Okay, stooop! It's all over~
You are…!
Riko Mine!!
Heya, Houkin!\nBut we don't have time to play around~
It's a withdrawal order, Jehanne.
I repeat, this is an order.
…Hmph!
Sorry to intrude~☆
…Those two were working together.
They got away, huh.
Shirayuki-chan is safe,\nso all's well for now, I guess?
Everyone, I'm so sorry for all the trouble.
I got a recruitment email from Jehanne, for the Yiu…
When I refused,\nshe threatened to blow up Butei High next,\nso…
So she threatened to bomb them if you didn't keep it secret.\nBut thinking you could solve it alone\nwas a big mistake.
Houki-san…
That's right, Shirayuki-chan.
If something painful or troubling happens,\nyou can tell us anything.\nBecause we're friends!
Friends… I'm not worthy of that…
You don't need any qualifications!\nI want to be friends with Shirayuki-chan.\nWhat about you, Shirayuki-chan?
I…
We come from different worlds to begin with…\nWe each have our status and position, but\nshouldn't what matters be our feelings?
Feelings…?
Haruka-san really loves Shirayuki-san, y'know.\nSo how about you, Shirayuki-san?\nOkay, confession time—go!
H-huh!?
Um, when Haruka-san said she wanted to be friends,\nI was actually happy… but scared.\nScared of dragging such a kind person into trouble.
Uh-huh, uh-huh, and?
Hey, stop teasing.
I've never had a single friend,\nand I don't know what to do…\nbut if that's okay with you… yes.
We got an OK!
I said stop teasing!
Yaaay!! Woohoo!!
Haruka, you're getting too excited!
Ehehe, because… being Shirayuki-chan's friend\nnumber one makes me happy.
Woo! Shirayuki-san's first!
Stop saying things that invite misunderstanding!
Nice to meet you, Shirayuki-chan!\nOnce again, I'm Haruka Minazuki!\nThank you for being my friend!
I'm Shirayuki Hoshiga. I'm still inexperienced,\nbut um, please be nice to me!
Shirayukii-chaaan!!
Hya!?
Haruka sticks to you like a magnet.\nYou'd better brace yourself.
Speaking from experience, huh!
…Maybe you should experience it yourself, Koto.
Are you finished talking?
Huh? Reki-san, what are you eating?
Nom nom…
A snack?
It's a meal.
That!? Does it fill you up?
I've finished eating, so let's head back.
Thank you too, Reki.
…I merely carried out the request.
She's skilled, but so unfriendly…
Says you, Houki-san?
What?
Kidding, kidding! You're funny, Houki-san!
No! Houki-chan is cute!
C-cu…? What are you saying!?
See, you ARE funny!
She's cute, I tell you!
(…a quick glance)
You're cute too, Shirayuki-chan!
Sheesh,\nlet's just say everyone's cute!
W-wait, include me too, indeed~!!
(This kind of scene is truly lovely.\nA girl's cuteness is living art.)
Haa, is that so…
Good morning!
Umm…?
Explain yourself, Shirayuki.\nWhat's with that luggage?
These are my travel preparations.\nI've decided to go with everyone.
What?
Since then, I've researched and studied\nwhat friends are.
I learned that friends are truly friends\nonly when they show their feelings through actions—\ndoing what they can for each other.
And that explains the luggage?
Because if I don't act together with my friends,\nI can't help them.
Won't you be punished\nfor leaving the shrine and school?
I'm prepared for that.\nAnd if it's an accident,\nit shouldn't count as breaking the ban.
Shirayuki-chan…
Am I… a bother…?
No! You're super welcome!\nThank you, Shirayuki-chan!
Yes!
So, how do we get\nto another world from here?
Based on the pattern so far,\nif we go to where that light appeared once,\nthe light appears again, indeed.
Seems like the places are fixed.\nLike, places that lit up once\nlit up again?
Then should we go to where Aria disappeared?
Shirayuki, can you guide us there?
Yes.
This is where Aria disappeared.
Just a normal street, huh?
Doesn't look like anything special.
Butei High thoroughly investigated this site,\nbut found nothing suspicious.
That's right, indeed.\nNo clues even after investigating, indeed.
It's a mystery.\nHow that light is generated—\neven I, a magician, can't figure it out.
If Butei High investigated and found nothing,\nthere's nothing we can do…
Come to think of it, Shirayuki-san, what about school?\nWon't you be skipping class?
At Butei High, credits aren't just from classes—\nyou can also earn them\nby completing requests for Butei High.
If I complete the search for Aria—listed as missing—as a request,\nmy credits will be fine.
Credits, huh…
Houki-chan, what's wrong?
No, it's just… hearing about credits…
(How many days has it been since I left IS Academy?\nI should at least report that I'm safe…)
(Still, I don't know when I can return.\nNo telling when I'll get to report…)
Hm?
Huh? Isn't this… it?
C-can I… go too?
(This is… no, surely not)
